details:
This is a feature I have been wondering about for some time now, and am curious as to whether it is a topic the VRChat developers would even remotely consider.

I propose adding some kind of deferred downloading system for worlds, in which a worlds developer can add a specific SDK component to a gameobject, or some similar system. This system would then cause that gameobjects children, and unique assets associated with them, to be packed into their own unique asset bundle, which is then uploaded alongside the main bundle to the servers. When the world is loaded, only the “main” asset bundle is downloaded before the player can enter. The main asset bundle can include whatever is not packaged in one of these custom-defined bundles, as well as any assets that are used by more than one bundle.

World creators would then have access to those “deferred download” components at runtime, and using Udon we would be able to request that the game download the predefined bundle created at upload time, and then insert it into the scene.

I am well aware that VRChat is focused on security and is not the biggest fan of allowing world maintainers to create arbitrary requests – I specifically ask not that we can control what gets downloaded at runtime, only *when* a certain thing is downloaded. 

This, alongside pre-downloading (which is beyond this post’s scope) would greatly decrease loading times as worlds would only have to download what is needed, rather than the entire world. This would also work well for worlds which make heavy use of exclusive content. Why wait longer at the loading screen to download all that content if you aren’t meant to see it?

This could be made even better if users could somehow use this feature for delta-updates to worlds, but I see that as even less likely :P Also, if there are concerns about this being used to circumvent the Quest world size limitation, I think the SDK could just calculate the total size of all asset bundles to see if its beyond the limit.

(I even have an, albeit poor, example of what this could look like to an end user here: https://i.gyazo.com/c63d42ca524d65fd6d09d7efe346e830.mp4)
title: Consider adding a deferred downloading system for worlds
